target_customer: Fraud, financial crimes and compliance teams at banks, credit unions and fintechs
problem: Analysts drown in alerts and stitch context across tools by hand; reviews can take a full day.
business_model: Enterprise B2B software, agents integrated into existing fraud stacks
product_category: AI agents for fraud and compliance operations

founders.name: Riya Jagetia
founders.background_notes: Built agents and ML for fraud investigations per YC page.

technical_complexity.rationale: Agents must reason over bank data with explainable outputs and integrate with FICO, Actimize and Verafin, plus SOC 2 Type II, which is demanding for a small team.

defensibility.rationale: Deep bank integrations, security certification and audit-ready outputs raise switching costs; the underlying LLM approach is copyable.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: Sardine marketed agentic fraud and AML operations; no acquisition of Socratix found.

market_need_then: Fraud teams face high alert volume and false positives; founders cite hundreds of alerts per week per team and first hand experience at DoorDash and Unit21.

branding.domain_note: Uses getsocratix.ai rather than an exact name .com.

identity.voice_and_tone: Direct and outcome focused; 'Built for the Main Street' tagline

brand_strength.rationale: Name origin unstated; get-prefixed domain; no press on brand itself.

outcome_analysis: Socratix raised a $4.1M seed led by Pear VC in October 2025, shortly after its Summer 2025 YC batch, with founders from DoorDash, Unit21, Cruise and LinkedIn. It names bank and fintech case studies and presented at Finovate Spring 2026. It is early, active and without exit, and faces better funded fraud platforms adding agents.
notes: Seed confirmed by the company site, SiliconAngle, Pear VC and the press release (snippets). One aggregator lists a $500K YC seed in January 2025 and totals of $4.6M or $8M; unverified and not recorded. The site claim of a Money20/20 2026 award was not found in a second source. No dated competitor sources near the batch, so list empty.
